some-argue-that.zh: 有人认为（比 Some people think 书面）

prevention-is-better-than-cure.zh: 预防胜于治疗（固定说法）

widening-gap-between-rich-and-poor.en: widening gap between rich and poor

at-risk-of.zh: 面临……的危险（put X at risk of）

it-adj-for-to.en: It is + 形容词 + for 人 + to do

the-more-the-more.en: The + 比较级 …, the + 比较级 …

increasing-number.en: an increasing number of + 复数名词

have-effect-on.en: have a + 形容词 + effect on

it-takes.en: It takes + 人 + 时间 + to do

no-matter-how.en: No matter how + 形容词 + 主语 + 谓语

play-role-in.en: play a + 形容词 + role in

number-of-has.en: the number of + 复数名词 + 单数谓语（is / has）

make-it-easier.en: make it easier/harder for + 人 + to do
make-it-easier.zh: 让某人更容易/更难做某事

find-it-adj.en: find it + 形容词 + to do

adj-enough.zh: 足够……（enough 放在形容词后）

when-it-comes-to.en: When it comes to + 名词/doing

not-all.en: Not all + 名词 + 谓语

each-of-has.en: Each of the + 复数名词 + 单数谓语

if-will.en: If + 一般现在时, … will do

problem-is-that.en: The problem is that + 句子

one-of-is.en: One of the + (最高级) + 复数名词 + is

despite.zh: 尽管（后接名词，不接句子）

a-number-of.en: A number of + 复数名词 + 复数谓语

enough-noun.zh: 足够的……（enough 放在名词前）

fewer-and-fewer.en: fewer and fewer + 可数名词

sentences.zh: 一些人认为，大学的首要任务应是培养批判性思维，而不仅仅是为学生就业做准备。
sentences.en: Some argue that the primary role of a university should be to cultivate critical thinking, rather than merely to prepare students for employment.
k: 有人认为（比 Some people think 书面）
sentences.trap: Some people think the first task of university is to train critical thinking, not only prepare students for finding jobs.
sentences.tip: "任务"不必译成 task；"就业"用名词 employment，比 finding jobs 正式。
alts: Some contend that universities should prioritise developing critical thinking over simply preparing students for the job market.

sentences.zh: 死记硬背也许能帮学生通过考试，却很难让他们真正理解所学的内容。
sentences.en: Rote learning may help students pass exams, but it rarely leads to a genuine understanding of the material.
sentences.trap: Memorizing by heart may help students pass exams, but it is hard to let them really understand what they learn.
sentences.tip: "让某人……"别直译成 let，改成"A 带来 B"的结构：lead to / result in。
alts: Memorisation may get students through exams, but it seldom produces real understanding.

sentences.zh: 随着网络课程日益普及，偏远地区的学生也能接触到优质的教育资源。
sentences.en: With the growing popularity of online courses, students in remote areas now have access to high-quality educational resources.
sentences.trap: As online courses become more and more popular, students in remote areas can also touch high-quality education resources.
sentences.tip: "日益……"用 growing / increasing 修饰名词，比 more and more 紧凑。"接触资源"是 have access to，不是 touch。

sentences.zh: 人工智能在提高效率的同时，也引发了人们对大规模失业的担忧。
sentences.en: While artificial intelligence boosts efficiency, it has also raised concerns about large-scale job losses.
sentences.trap: Artificial intelligence improves efficiency at the same time, it also causes people's worry about big unemployment.
sentences.tip: "在……的同时"用 While 引导从句。两个完整句只用逗号相连（comma splice）是中国考生最常见的语法扣分点。
alts: Although AI improves efficiency, it has also sparked fears of mass unemployment.

sentences.zh: 过度依赖智能手机可能会削弱人们集中注意力的能力。
sentences.en: Excessive reliance on smartphones may undermine people's ability to concentrate.
sentences.trap: Too much depending on smartphones may weaken people's ability of focusing attention.
sentences.tip: 把动词"依赖"转成名词 reliance 做主语，句子更书面。ability 后面接 to do。

sentences.zh: 社交媒体拉近了人与人之间的距离，但讽刺的是，许多用户反而觉得比以往更孤独。
sentences.en: Social media has brought people closer together, yet ironically, many users report feeling lonelier than ever.
sentences.trap: Social media makes people's connection closer, but ironic is that many users feel more lonely.
sentences.tip: "拉近距离"不必译出"距离"。report feeling 是学术写作转述研究结果的常用说法。

sentences.zh: 如果不立即采取行动，气候变化的后果将无法逆转。
sentences.en: Unless immediate action is taken, the consequences of climate change will be irreversible.
sentences.trap: If we don't take action immediately, the result of climate change will be unable to reverse.
sentences.tip: 中文常省略主语，英文可以用被动 action is taken，不必硬加 we。
alts: Without immediate action, the effects of climate change could become irreversible.

sentences.zh: 政府应通过税收优惠鼓励企业改用可再生能源。
sentences.en: Governments should offer tax incentives to encourage businesses to switch to renewable energy.
sentences.trap: Government should encourage companies to use renewable energy through tax preferential.
sentences.tip: "通过 X 做 Y"可以拆成"提供 X 来做 Y"：offer X to do Y，比 through 自然。

sentences.zh: 个人的环保努力固然重要，但真正的改变需要在系统层面推动。
sentences.en: Individual efforts to protect the environment matter, but meaningful change requires action at a systemic level.
sentences.trap: Personal environmental efforts are of course important, but the real change needs system level change.
sentences.tip: "固然重要"直接用动词 matter，简洁有力。"真正的"用 meaningful，比 real 更贴切。

sentences.zh: 久坐不动的生活方式是肥胖率上升的主要原因之一。
sentences.en: A sedentary lifestyle is one of the main factors behind rising obesity rates.
sentences.trap: Sitting for a long time without moving lifestyle is one of the main reasons that cause the obesity rate to rise.
sentences.tip: 一个精准的词（sedentary）顶一整串描述。"上升的 X"用 rising 放在名词前。

sentences.zh: 预防胜于治疗，因此应将更多公共卫生经费投入健康教育。
sentences.en: Prevention is better than cure, so more public health funding should be directed towards health education.
k: 预防胜于治疗（固定说法）
sentences.trap: Prevention is better than treatment, so public health investment should be used more on health education.
sentences.tip: 谚语要用固定说法里的 cure，不要自己换成 treatment。

sentences.zh: 心理健康问题长期被忽视，部分原因是社会对其仍有偏见。
sentences.en: Mental health problems have long been overlooked, partly because of the stigma still attached to them.
sentences.trap: Mental health problems are ignored for a long time, part of the reason is society still has prejudice to them.
sentences.tip: "长期"配现在完成时 have long been。"部分原因是"用 partly because of 接在后面，不要另起一句。

sentences.zh: 城市化进程加快，导致住房短缺和交通拥堵问题日益严重。
sentences.en: Rapid urbanisation has led to worsening housing shortages and traffic congestion.
sentences.trap: The process of urbanization speeds up, which leads to housing shortage and traffic jam problems becoming more and more serious.
sentences.tip: "进程""问题"这类范畴词通常不译。"加快"变成形容词 rapid。
alts: As cities grow rapidly, housing shortages and traffic congestion are becoming increasingly severe.

sentences.zh: 与其修建更多道路，不如投资公共交通，因为新修的道路往往只会吸引更多车流。
sentences.en: Rather than building more roads, cities should invest in public transport, as new roads tend to attract more traffic.
sentences.trap: Instead of building more roads, it's better to invest public transport, because new roads often only attract more cars.
sentences.tip: "与其……不如……"用 Rather than doing，主语 should do。补上主语 cities，句子就有了行动者。

sentences.zh: 年轻人涌入大城市寻找机会，使许多农村地区面临人口老龄化问题。
sentences.en: The influx of young people into big cities in search of opportunities has left many rural areas with an ageing population.
sentences.trap: Young people pour into big cities to find opportunities, making many rural areas face the problem of population aging.
sentences.tip: 把"涌入"名词化（influx）作主语，一句话就能承载因果，不必用 making 分词。

sentences.zh: 远程办公给员工带来了更大的灵活性，但也模糊了工作与生活之间的界限。
sentences.en: Remote working gives employees greater flexibility, but it also blurs the line between work and home life.
sentences.trap: Remote work provides staffs more flexibility, but also makes the boundary of work and life fuzzy.
sentences.tip: "模糊界限"用固定搭配 blur the line。staff 是集体名词，不加 s。

sentences.zh: 薪酬固然重要，但工作满意度在很大程度上取决于员工是否感到被重视。
sentences.en: Pay matters, of course, but job satisfaction depends largely on whether employees feel valued.
sentences.trap: Salary is of course important, but job satisfaction largely decides on whether being recognized.
sentences.tip: "取决于"是 depend on，不是 decide on。"被重视"用 feel + 过去分词，不必写成完整被动句。

sentences.zh: 在瞬息万变的就业市场中，终身学习已不再是一种选择，而是一种必需。
sentences.en: In a fast-changing job market, lifelong learning is no longer optional; it is essential.
sentences.trap: In the fast changing job market, lifelong learning is not a choice anymore, but a necessary.
sentences.tip: "不是 A 而是 B"用分号连两个短句，节奏更有力。necessary 是形容词，不能当名词用。
alts: In a rapidly changing job market, lifelong learning has become a necessity rather than a choice.

sentences.zh: 政府有责任确保所有公民无论收入高低，都能享有基本医疗服务。
sentences.en: Governments have a responsibility to ensure that all citizens, regardless of income, have access to basic healthcare.
sentences.trap: Government has the responsibility to make sure all citizens no matter income high or low can get basic medical service.
sentences.tip: "无论高低、无论多少"只需 regardless of + 名词，"高低"不用译。

sentences.zh: 仅靠加重刑罚并不能有效减少犯罪，关键在于解决其根源。
sentences.en: Harsher punishments alone will not significantly reduce crime; the key lies in tackling its root causes.
sentences.trap: Only relying on heavier punishment cannot reduce crime effectively, solving its root problem is the key.
sentences.tip: "仅靠 X"用 X alone 后置，简洁地道。两个完整句之间用分号，不用逗号。
alts: Tougher sentences on their own will not cut crime significantly; what matters is addressing why people offend in the first place.

sentences.zh: 贫富差距不断扩大可能会威胁社会稳定。
sentences.en: A widening gap between rich and poor could pose a threat to social stability.
k: widening gap between rich and poor
sentences.trap: The enlarging of the gap between rich and poor may threaten society stable.
sentences.tip: "不断扩大的"用 widening。修饰名词要用形容词 social，不用名词 society。

sentences.zh: 全球化推动了经济增长，但也使许多地方文化面临消失的危险。
sentences.en: Globalisation has fuelled economic growth, but it has also put many local cultures at risk of disappearing.
k: 面临……的危险（put X at risk of）
sentences.trap: Globalization promotes economic growth at the same time, it also makes many local cultures face the risk of disappearing.
sentences.tip: "使 X 面临"不要写成 make X face，用 put X at risk of。fuel 比 promote 更生动。

sentences.zh: 旅游业为当地带来了收入，但大批游客也给环境和基础设施造成了压力。
sentences.en: Tourism brings income to local communities, but large numbers of visitors also put pressure on the environment and infrastructure.
sentences.trap: Tourism brings income to local, but large amount of tourists also bring pressure to environment and infrastructure.
sentences.tip: local 是形容词，"当地"要补名词 communities。可数名词用 numbers of，不用 amount of。

sentences.zh: 学习外语不只是掌握一项技能，更是了解另一种思维方式的窗口。
sentences.en: Learning a foreign language is not just about acquiring a skill; it offers a window into a different way of thinking.
sentences.trap: Learning a foreign language is not only mastering a tool, but also a way to understand another thinking way.
sentences.tip: "思维方式"是 way of thinking，不是 thinking way。

sentences.zh: 在信息爆炸的时代，辨别真假信息的能力变得前所未有地重要。
sentences.en: In an age of information overload, the ability to tell fact from fiction has never been more important.
sentences.trap: In the era of information explosion, the ability to distinguish true and false information becomes unprecedentedly important.
sentences.tip: "前所未有地重要"用否定比较 has never been more…，比 unprecedentedly 自然得多。
alts: In an era of information overload, being able to distinguish truth from falsehood matters more than ever.

sentences.zh: 广告常常利用人们的不安全感，推销他们并不需要的产品。
sentences.en: Advertising often exploits people's insecurities to sell them products they do not need.
sentences.trap: Advertisements often use people's sense of insecurity to sell products they don't need.
sentences.tip: 贬义的"利用"用 exploit。正式写作避免 don't 这类缩写。

sentences.zh: 研究表明，充足的睡眠与更好的学习成绩之间存在密切联系。
sentences.en: Research suggests a strong link between adequate sleep and better academic performance.
sentences.trap: Research shows that there is a close relationship between enough sleep and better study results.
sentences.tip: 相关不等于因果，用 suggests 比 shows 更严谨。去掉 there is，句子更紧凑。
alts: Studies indicate that getting enough sleep is closely associated with better academic results.

sentences.zh: 尽管这项技术前景广阔，但其长期影响仍有待进一步研究。
sentences.en: Although the technology shows considerable promise, its long-term effects warrant further investigation.
sentences.trap: Although this technology has a broad prospect, but its long-term influence still needs to be researched further.
sentences.tip: Although 和 but 不能同时用。"前景广阔"不是 broad prospect，而是 show promise。

sentences.zh: 这一发现挑战了一个长期以来被广泛接受的观点。
sentences.en: This finding challenges a long-held and widely accepted assumption.
sentences.trap: This discovery challenged a view which has been widely accepted for a long time.
sentences.tip: 用复合形容词 long-held 放在名词前，代替冗长的定语从句。研究结论用 finding，不用 discovery。

sentences.zh: 资金短缺仍是阻碍发展中国家科研进步的主要障碍之一。
sentences.en: A lack of funding remains one of the main obstacles to scientific progress in developing countries.
sentences.trap: Fund shortage is one of the main obstacles hindering developing countries pushing forward scientific research.
sentences.tip: "阻碍……的障碍"语义重复，英文只要 obstacle to。"仍是"一个 remains 就够了。
alts: Insufficient funding is still one of the biggest barriers to scientific progress in developing countries.

sentences.zh: 对很多学生来说，同时学好几门科目并不容易。
sentences.en: It is not easy for many students to study several subjects at the same time.
sentences.trap: For many students, study several subjects at the same time is not easy.
sentences.tip: 中文把"做某事"放在开头，英文先用 It is … 占住主语位置，再把 to do 放到后面，句子不会头重脚轻。
alts: Studying several subjects at the same time is not easy for many students.

sentences.zh: 孩子越早开始学外语，就越容易说得流利。
sentences.en: The earlier children start learning a foreign language, the easier it is for them to become fluent.
sentences.trap: More early children start to learn a foreign language, more easily they speak fluently.
sentences.tip: "越……越……"是 the + 比较级 …, the + 比较级 …，两个 the 都不能省，中间用逗号隔开。

sentences.zh: 课堂上主动提问的学生，通常比一言不发的学生学到更多。
sentences.en: Those who ask questions in class usually learn more than those who stay silent.
sentences.trap: Students actively ask questions in class usually learn more than students keep silent.
sentences.tip: 中文"……的学生"在英文里要放到名词后面，用 who 引出；who 不能省，否则一句里会出现两个谓语。
alts: Students who ask questions in class usually learn more than students who stay silent.

sentences.zh: 一些家长认为，孩子的成绩在很大程度上取决于他们是否努力。
sentences.en: Some parents believe that a child's grades depend largely on whether they work hard.
sentences.trap: Some parents think children's grades are largely decided by if they are hardworking or not.
sentences.tip: "取决于是否"用 depend on whether + 完整句子；whether 引出的整个句子相当于一个名词。

sentences.zh: 很多学生在手机上花了太多时间，以至于没有时间读书。
sentences.en: Many students spend so much time on their phones that they have no time to read.
sentences.trap: Many students spend too much time to use phones, so that they have no time reading.
sentences.tip: "以至于"用 so + much/形容词 + that + 句子，把因果装进一句话；spend 后面接 on + 名词。

sentences.zh: 网上购物让人们在家就能买到几乎任何东西。
sentences.en: Online shopping allows people to buy almost anything from home.
sentences.trap: Online shopping lets people can buy almost everything at home.
sentences.tip: allow 的句型是 allow + 人 + to do；let 后面直接接动词原形。两种句型后面都不能再加 can。

sentences.zh: 越来越多的老年人开始用智能手机和家人保持联系。
sentences.en: An increasing number of older people are using smartphones to keep in touch with their families.
sentences.trap: More and more old people begins to use smartphone to keep touch with family.
sentences.tip: an increasing number of 后面接复数名词，谓语也用复数；"保持联系"是 keep in touch with，in 不能漏。

sentences.zh: 虽然科技让生活更方便了，但也让人变得更懒了。
sentences.en: Although technology has made life more convenient, it has also made people lazier.
sentences.trap: Although technology makes life more convenient, but it also makes people become lazier.
sentences.tip: Although 和 but 只能用一个；make 后面直接接宾语 + 形容词，中间不加 become。

sentences.zh: 网上的信息太多了，人们很难判断哪些是真的。
sentences.en: There is so much information online that it is hard for people to tell which is true.
sentences.trap: The information on the internet is too much, people are difficult to judge which is true.
sentences.tip: 两个分句之间没有连词时，用 so … that 连成一句；"人们很难"不能写 people are difficult，要写 it is hard for people to。

sentences.zh: 如果我们不减少塑料的使用，海洋污染会越来越严重。
sentences.en: Unless we reduce the use of plastic, ocean pollution will get worse and worse.
sentences.trap: If we don't reduce using plastic, the ocean pollution will be more and more serious.
sentences.tip: "如果不"可以用 Unless 加肯定句；条件从句用一般现在时，主句用 will。
alts: If we do not reduce the use of plastic, ocean pollution will get worse and worse.

sentences.zh: 骑自行车上班不仅能减少污染，还能让人保持健康。
sentences.en: Cycling to work not only reduces pollution but also helps people stay healthy.
sentences.trap: Ride bicycle to work not only reduce pollution, but also make people keep healthy.
sentences.tip: 动作做主语要用 doing（Cycling），谓语跟着加 s；not only 和 but also 后面的结构要对称。

sentences.zh: 政府应该鼓励人们乘坐公共交通，而不是开私家车。
sentences.en: The government should encourage people to use public transport instead of driving their own cars.
sentences.trap: The government should encourage people take public transport, not drive private cars.
sentences.tip: encourage + 人 + to do，to 不能漏；instead of 是介词，后面的动词要用 doing。

sentences.zh: 气候变化使极端天气越来越频繁，这给农民带来了很大的困难。
sentences.en: Climate change has led to more frequent extreme weather, which has caused serious problems for farmers.
sentences.trap: Climate change makes extreme weather more and more frequent, this brings farmers big difficulties.
sentences.tip: 中文的"这"指代前面整件事时，英文用 , which 接下去；用 this 另起一句再用逗号连，就成了两个句子硬连。

sentences.zh: 每天锻炼半小时对健康有积极的影响。
sentences.en: Exercising for half an hour every day has a positive effect on your health.
sentences.trap: Exercise half an hour every day has positive influence to health.
sentences.tip: 动作做主语用 doing；"对……有影响"是 have an effect on，介词用 on，effect 前要有冠词。

sentences.zh: 很多年轻人忙得没时间做饭，所以经常依赖快餐。
sentences.en: Many young people are too busy to cook, so they often rely on fast food.
sentences.trap: Many young people are too busy that they have no time cooking, so they often eat fast food.
sentences.tip: too + 形容词 + to do 本身就有否定意思，不要再加 not，也不要和 that 混用。

sentences.zh: 医生建议人们少吃糖，以便降低患糖尿病的风险。
sentences.en: Doctors suggest that people should eat less sugar so that they can reduce the risk of diabetes.
sentences.trap: Doctors suggest people to eat less sugar in order to reduce the risk to get diabetes.
sentences.tip: suggest 不能接 人 + to do，要写 suggest that 人 (should) do；"以便"用 so that + 句子，通常带 can。

sentences.zh: 吸烟的人比不吸烟的人更容易得肺癌。
sentences.en: Those who smoke are much more likely to get lung cancer than those who do not.
sentences.trap: People who smoke have much bigger possibility to get lung cancer than people don't smoke.
sentences.tip: "……的可能性大"不要直译 possibility，用 be likely to do；比较时后一组人也要带 who。

sentences.zh: 在大城市，年轻人很难买得起房子。
sentences.en: In big cities, it is very difficult for young people to afford a house.
sentences.trap: In big cities, young people are very difficult to buy a house.
sentences.tip: "某人很难做某事"不能写 sb is difficult to do，要写 it is difficult for sb to do；"买得起"是 afford。

sentences.zh: 与农村相比，城市提供的工作机会多得多。
sentences.en: Compared with the countryside, cities offer many more job opportunities.
sentences.trap: Compare with countryside, city provides more work chances.
sentences.tip: "与……相比"放在句首用 Compared with；比较级前加 many / much 表示"多得多"。

sentences.zh: 交通太堵了，很多人上班要花一个多小时。
sentences.en: Traffic is so bad that it takes many people more than an hour to get to work.
sentences.trap: The traffic jam is very serious, many people spend more than one hour to go to work.
sentences.tip: "花多长时间做某事"可以用 it takes + 人 + 时间 + to do；前后两件事用 so … that 连成一句。

sentences.zh: 很多人搬到大城市的一个原因是在那里能挣到更高的工资。
sentences.en: One reason why many people move to big cities is that they can earn higher salaries there.
sentences.trap: Many people move to big cities, the reason is because the salary there is higher.
sentences.tip: "原因是"用 The reason why … is that …；不要写 the reason is because，意思重复了。

sentences.zh: 越来越多的人选择在家工作，而不是每天去办公室。
sentences.en: An increasing number of people choose to work from home instead of going to the office every day.
sentences.trap: More and more people choose working at home, not go to office every day.
sentences.tip: choose 后面接 to do；instead of 后面接 doing。

sentences.zh: 无论工作多辛苦，他从来都不抱怨。
sentences.en: No matter how hard his job is, he never complains about it.
sentences.trap: No matter how hard is the work, he never complains it.
sentences.tip: No matter how + 形容词 + 主语 + 谓语，语序和陈述句一样；complain 后面要加 about。

sentences.zh: 新员工花了好几个月才适应公司的工作方式。
sentences.en: It took the new employees several months to get used to the way the company works.
sentences.trap: The new staffs spent several months to get used to the company's working way.
sentences.tip: "花了多长时间才……"用 It took + 人 + 时间 + to do；staff 是集体名词，不加 s。

sentences.zh: 好的经理应该鼓励员工提出新想法。
sentences.en: A good manager should encourage employees to come up with new ideas.
sentences.trap: A good leader should encourage staffs put forward new ideas.
sentences.tip: encourage + 人 + to do；"提出想法"最常用 come up with ideas。

sentences.zh: 做志愿者可以帮助年轻人培养责任感。
sentences.en: Volunteering can help young people develop a sense of responsibility.
sentences.trap: Volunteer activities can help young people cultivating responsibility sense.
sentences.tip: help + 人 + 动词原形（to 可加可不加），不用 doing；"责任感"是 a sense of responsibility。

sentences.zh: 父母在帮助孩子成长方面起着非常重要的作用。
sentences.en: Parents play a very important role in helping their children grow up.
sentences.trap: Parents play a very important role in children's growing process.
sentences.tip: play a role in 后面接名词或 doing；"成长过程"不必直译 process，用 help children grow up 更直接。

sentences.zh: 一些人认为，应该禁止在公共场所吸烟，以保护不吸烟的人。
sentences.en: Some people believe that smoking should be banned in public places to protect those who do not smoke.
sentences.trap: Some people think public places should forbid smoking to protect people don't smoke.
sentences.tip: 被禁止的是"吸烟"，所以让 smoking 做主语，用被动 should be banned；"不吸烟的人"用 those who do not smoke。

sentences.zh: 犯罪率上升的一个原因是失业的人越来越多。
sentences.en: One reason why crime rates are rising is that the number of unemployed people has increased.
sentences.trap: One reason of crime rate rising is because unemployed people become more and more.
sentences.tip: "……越来越多"可以改写成"……的数量增加了"：the number of + 复数名词，谓语用单数 has。

sentences.zh: 出国旅行可以让年轻人了解不同的文化。
sentences.en: Travelling abroad allows young people to learn about different cultures.
sentences.trap: Travel abroad can let young people know different culture.
sentences.tip: 动作做主语用 doing；"了解文化"用 learn about，know 只表示"知道"。

sentences.zh: 和过去相比，现在的年轻人读的纸质书少多了。
sentences.en: Compared with the past, young people today read far fewer printed books.
sentences.trap: Compare with past, nowadays young people read less paper books.
sentences.tip: 可数名词的"更少"用 fewer，不可数名词用 less；"纸质书"是 printed books。

sentences.zh: 很多老人以前常去电影院，但现在更喜欢在家看电视。
sentences.en: Many older people used to go to the cinema, but now they prefer to watch TV at home.
sentences.trap: Many old people were used to go to cinema, but now they more like watching TV at home.
sentences.tip: "过去常常"是 used to do；be used to doing 是"习惯于"，两个不要混。

sentences.zh: 传统节日之所以重要，是因为它们能把家人聚在一起。
sentences.en: What makes traditional festivals important is that they bring families together.
sentences.trap: Traditional festivals are important is because they make family get together.
sentences.tip: "之所以……是因为……"可以写成 What makes … important is that …；最简单的写法是 … are important because …。
alts: Traditional festivals are important because they bring families together.

sentences.zh: 孩子们花太多时间看视频，这对他们的视力不好。
sentences.en: Children spend too much time watching videos, which is bad for their eyesight.
sentences.trap: Children spend too much time to watch videos, this is harmful to their eyes.
sentences.tip: spend + 时间 + doing，不是 to do；指代前面整件事用 , which。

sentences.zh: 社交媒体让人们更容易和朋友保持联系。
sentences.en: Social media makes it easier for people to keep in touch with their friends.
sentences.trap: Social media makes people more easily keep contact with friends.
sentences.tip: "让某人更容易做"用 make it easier for sb to do，it 是占位的形式宾语，不能省。

sentences.zh: 虽然网上新闻更新很快，但不一定可靠。
sentences.en: Although online news is updated quickly, it is not always reliable.
sentences.trap: Although online news updates very fast, but it is not always reliable.
sentences.tip: Although 后面不能再用 but；news 是被更新的，用被动 is updated，而且 news 是不可数名词，谓语用单数。

sentences.zh: 广告让孩子们想买很多他们并不真正需要的东西。
sentences.en: Advertisements make children want to buy many things that they do not really need.
sentences.trap: Advertisements make children want to buy many things they are not really need.
sentences.tip: make + 人 + 动词原形，中间不加 to；"他们不需要的东西"用 things that they do not need。

sentences.zh: 科学家希望这种新药能帮助病人更快康复。
sentences.en: Scientists hope that this new medicine will help patients recover more quickly.
sentences.trap: Scientists hope this new medicine can help patients recovering faster.
sentences.tip: hope that + 完整句子；help + 人 + 动词原形（help patients recover），不用 doing。

sentences.zh: 这项研究表明，睡眠不足会让人更难集中注意力。
sentences.en: This study shows that a lack of sleep makes it harder for people to concentrate.
sentences.trap: This research shows sleep not enough will make people more difficult to concentrate.
sentences.tip: 把"睡眠不足"转成名词短语 a lack of sleep 做主语；"让人更难做"用 make it harder for sb to do。

sentences.zh: 很多实验是在动物身上做的，这引起了一些伦理问题。
sentences.en: Many experiments are carried out on animals, which raises some ethical questions.
sentences.trap: Many experiments are done in animals, this causes some moral problems.
sentences.tip: "实验是……做的"用被动 be carried out；指代前面整件事用 , which，后面谓语用单数。

sentences.zh: 太空探索太昂贵了，很多国家负担不起。
sentences.en: Space exploration is too expensive for many countries to afford.
sentences.trap: Space exploration is too expensive that many countries can't afford it.
sentences.tip: too … for sb to do 已经包含否定；不要和 that 混用，句末也不要再加 it。

sentences.zh: 只要学生每天坚持练习，他们的英语就会进步。
sentences.en: As long as students keep practising every day, their English will improve.
sentences.trap: Only if students insist practising every day, their English will be improved.
sentences.tip: "只要"用 As long as + 一般现在时，主句用 will；"坚持做"是 keep doing，insist 后面不能直接接 doing。

sentences.zh: 学生读的书越多，写作能力提高得就越快。
sentences.en: The more books students read, the faster their writing skills improve.
sentences.trap: Students read more books, their writing level improves faster.
sentences.tip: "越……越……"把两个比较级都提到句首：The more books …, the faster …，后面再接主语和谓语。

sentences.zh: 很多大学让学生去实习，以便为将来的工作做准备。
sentences.en: Many universities ask students to do an internship so that they can prepare for their future jobs.
sentences.trap: Many universities let students to do internship for preparing their future jobs.
sentences.tip: 目的用 so that + 句子（常带 can）；"为……做准备"是 prepare for，for 不能漏。

sentences.zh: 一个学生能否成功，更多取决于他是否喜欢学习，而不是他有多聪明。
sentences.en: A student's success depends more on whether they enjoy learning than on how clever they are.
sentences.trap: A student can success or not depends on he likes study or not, not how clever is he.
sentences.tip: 把"能否成功"变成名词 success 做主语，后面用 depends on whether + 句子；how clever they are 是陈述语序。

sentences.zh: 网课让学生可以按照自己的节奏学习。
sentences.en: Online courses allow students to learn at their own pace.
sentences.trap: Online courses let students can learn according to their own speed.
sentences.tip: allow + 人 + to do，后面不加 can；"按自己的节奏"是固定说法 at one's own pace。

sentences.zh: 很多学生觉得在别人面前说英语很难。
sentences.en: Many students find it difficult to speak English in front of others.
sentences.trap: Many students feel speaking English in front of others is difficult.
sentences.tip: "觉得做某事很……"用 find it + 形容词 + to do，it 先占位，真正的内容放在 to do 里。

sentences.zh: 有些学生不够自信，不敢在课堂上提问。
sentences.en: Some students are not confident enough to ask questions in class.
sentences.trap: Some students are not enough confident to ask question in class.
sentences.tip: enough 修饰形容词时放在形容词后面：confident enough to do。

sentences.zh: 每天花好几个小时玩手机的孩子更容易出现视力问题。
sentences.en: Children who spend hours playing on their phones are more likely to have eye problems.
sentences.trap: Children spend many hours to play phones every day are easier to have eye problems.
sentences.tip: "……的孩子"用 who 引出；"更容易出现……"不是 easier to，而是 more likely to。

sentences.zh: 智能手机不仅改变了我们交流的方式，也改变了我们购物的方式。
sentences.en: Smartphones have changed not only the way we communicate but also the way we shop.
sentences.trap: Smartphones not only changed our communicating way, but also changed our shopping way.
sentences.tip: "……的方式"用 the way + 句子（the way we shop）；not only 和 but also 后面放结构相同的部分。

sentences.zh: 说到网络安全，很多人还是不够小心。
sentences.en: When it comes to online safety, many people are still not careful enough.
sentences.trap: Talking about online safety, many people are still not enough careful.
sentences.tip: "说到……"可以用 When it comes to + 名词开头；enough 放在形容词后面。

sentences.zh: 我爷爷以前常写信，现在他更喜欢给我们发语音消息。
sentences.en: My grandfather used to write letters, but now he prefers to send us voice messages.
sentences.trap: My grandfather was used to write letters, now he more likes to send us voice messages.
sentences.tip: "以前常常"是 used to do；"更喜欢"用 prefer to do，不说 more like；两个句子之间加 but。

sentences.zh: 网上的个人信息应该得到更好的保护。
sentences.en: Personal information online should be better protected.
sentences.trap: Personal information on internet should get better protect.
sentences.tip: 信息是被保护的，用被动 should be protected；副词 better 放在 be 和过去分词之间。

sentences.zh: 即使只有一个人少用塑料袋，也能对环境产生积极的影响。
sentences.en: Even if only one person uses fewer plastic bags, it can have a positive effect on the environment.
sentences.trap: Even one person uses less plastic bags, it also can have positive influence to environment.
sentences.tip: "即使"用 Even if + 句子；bags 是可数名词，"更少"用 fewer。

sentences.zh: 为了保护野生动物，很多森林应该被划为自然保护区。
sentences.en: In order to protect wild animals, many forests should be turned into nature reserves.
sentences.trap: For protecting wild animals, many forests should be listed as protect areas.
sentences.tip: "为了做某事"用 In order to do，不用 for doing；森林是被划为保护区，用被动。

sentences.zh: 空气污染太严重了，很多人出门不得不戴口罩。
sentences.en: Air pollution has become so bad that many people have to wear masks outside.
sentences.trap: The air pollution is too serious, many people must wear masks when go out.
sentences.tip: 两个分句用 so … that 连成一句；"不得不"用 have to，表示外部情况迫使。

sentences.zh: 并不是所有环保产品都像广告说的那么环保。
sentences.en: Not all green products are as eco-friendly as their advertisements claim.
sentences.trap: All green products are not as environmental friendly as advertisements say.
sentences.tip: "并非所有"用 Not all … 开头；All … are not 容易被理解成"全都不"。

sentences.zh: 全球变暖导致海平面上升，这对沿海城市是一种威胁。
sentences.en: Global warming has led to rising sea levels, which is a threat to coastal cities.
sentences.trap: Global warming leads sea level rise, this is a threat for coastal cities.
sentences.tip: lead 后面要加 to；"这"指代前面整件事，用 , which 接下去。

sentences.zh: 为了保持健康，人们每天应该至少走三十分钟。
sentences.en: In order to stay healthy, people should walk for at least thirty minutes every day.
sentences.trap: For keep healthy, people every day should walk at least thirty minutes.
sentences.tip: "为了"用 In order to + 动词原形；时间状语 every day 放在句末。

sentences.zh: 压力太大不仅影响睡眠，还会让人更容易生病。
sentences.en: Too much stress not only affects sleep but also makes people more likely to get ill.
sentences.trap: Too much pressure not only influences sleeping, but also lets people easier to get sick.
sentences.tip: "让人更容易生病"= make people more likely to get ill；not only / but also 后面都是动词。

sentences.zh: 对很多人来说，改掉熬夜的习惯很难。
sentences.en: It is hard for many people to give up the habit of staying up late.
sentences.trap: Many people are hard to change the habit of staying up late.
sentences.tip: "某人很难做某事"用 It is hard for sb to do；habit of 后面接 doing。

sentences.zh: 健康饮食的关键是均衡，而不是完全不吃某些食物。
sentences.en: The key to healthy eating is balance rather than cutting out certain foods completely.
sentences.trap: The key of healthy eating is balance, not completely don't eat some food.
sentences.tip: "……的关键"是 the key to，介词用 to；rather than 后面接 doing，和前面对比。

sentences.zh: 老年病人的数量每年都在增加，这给医院带来了压力。
sentences.en: The number of elderly patients is rising every year, which puts pressure on hospitals.
sentences.trap: The number of old patients are increasing every year, this brings pressure to hospitals.
sentences.tip: the number of 的中心词是 number，谓语用单数 is；"带来压力"是 put pressure on。

sentences.zh: 很多人觉得头几周过后很难坚持锻炼。
sentences.en: Many people find it hard to keep exercising after the first few weeks.
sentences.trap: Many people feel it is hard to insist exercising after the first few weeks.
sentences.tip: find it hard to do；"坚持做某事"用 keep doing。

sentences.zh: 饮食和运动对减肥都很重要。
sentences.en: Both diet and exercise are important for losing weight.
sentences.trap: Diet and exercise both are important to lose weight.
sentences.tip: "A 和 B 都"用 Both A and B 开头，谓语用复数；important for 后面接 doing。

sentences.zh: 在城里开车比坐地铁花的时间长得多。
sentences.en: It takes much longer to drive in the city than to take the underground.
sentences.trap: Driving in the city spends much more time than taking subway.
sentences.tip: "花时间"的主语不是事情本身，用 It takes + 时间 + to do；比较对象也用 to do 对齐。

sentences.zh: 与小城镇相比，大城市的生活成本要高得多。
sentences.en: Compared with small towns, the cost of living in big cities is much higher.
sentences.trap: Compare with small towns, big cities' living cost is more higher.
sentences.tip: 比较级前面用 much 表示"……得多"，不能说 more higher。

sentences.zh: 很多年轻人更喜欢住在市中心，因为那里交通方便。
sentences.en: Many young people prefer to live in the city centre because transport there is convenient.
sentences.trap: Many young people more like living in city center, because there transport is convenient.
sentences.tip: "更喜欢"用 prefer to do；"那里的交通"是 transport there，地点副词放在名词后面。

sentences.zh: 城市应该多建公园，让居民有地方放松。
sentences.en: Cities should build more parks so that residents have somewhere to relax.
sentences.trap: City should build more parks for residents have place to relax.
sentences.tip: for 后面不能接句子，目的用 so that + 句子；"有地方做某事"是 have somewhere to do。

sentences.zh: 无论城市变得多么现代，它仍然要应对交通问题。
sentences.en: No matter how modern a city becomes, it still has to deal with traffic problems.
sentences.trap: No matter how modern does a city become, it still needs to face the traffic problem.
sentences.tip: No matter how + 形容词 + 主语 + 谓语，不用倒装；"应对问题"常用 deal with。

sentences.zh: 小城镇的生活没有大城市方便，但是便宜得多。
sentences.en: Life in a small town is not as convenient as life in a big city, but it is much cheaper.
sentences.trap: The life of small town is not convenient as big city, but it is more cheaper.
sentences.tip: "没有……那么……"用 not as + 形容词 + as；比较的两边要对等：life in a small town 对 life in a big city。

sentences.zh: 很多人一边工作一边学习，这非常累。
sentences.en: Many people work and study at the same time, which is very tiring.
sentences.trap: Many people work while study, this is very tired.
sentences.tip: "一边……一边……"用 at the same time；让人累用 tiring，人自己觉得累用 tired。

sentences.zh: 员工工作时越开心，效率往往就越高。
sentences.en: The happier employees are at work, the more productive they tend to be.
sentences.trap: Employees are more happy at work, their working efficiency is higher.
sentences.tip: "越……越……"用 the + 比较级 + 主语 + 谓语；"往往"用 tend to do。

sentences.zh: 好老板会让员工自己做决定。
sentences.en: A good boss allows employees to make their own decisions.
sentences.trap: A good boss lets employees to make decisions by themselves.
sentences.tip: allow + 人 + to do；let 后面不加 to。"做决定"的动词用 make。

sentences.zh: 有些人宁愿少挣点钱，也不愿放弃空闲时间。
sentences.en: Some people would rather earn less money than give up their free time.
sentences.trap: Some people rather earn less money also don't want to give up their free time.
sentences.tip: "宁愿 A 也不 B"用 would rather do A than do B，两边都用动词原形。

sentences.zh: 很多公司要求员工加班，这会对他们的健康产生负面影响。
sentences.en: Many companies expect employees to work overtime, which can have a negative effect on their health.
sentences.trap: Many companies ask staffs work overtime, this will have negative influence on their health.
sentences.tip: expect + 人 + to do；指代前面整件事用 , which。

sentences.zh: 在家办公改变了很多人安排一天的方式。
sentences.en: Working from home has changed the way many people organise their day.
sentences.trap: Work at home has changed many people's arranging way of a day.
sentences.tip: 动作做主语用 doing；"……的方式"用 the way + 句子，不要堆成 arranging way。

sentences.zh: 只要每个人都遵守规则，社会就会更安全。
sentences.en: As long as everyone follows the rules, society will be safer.
sentences.trap: Only everyone obeys the rules, the society will be more safe.
sentences.tip: As long as 后面用一般现在时，everyone 是单数，动词加 s；safe 的比较级是 safer。

sentences.zh: 并不是所有家庭都负担得起送孩子上私立学校。
sentences.en: Not all families can afford to send their children to private schools.
sentences.trap: All families can't afford sending their children to private schools.
sentences.tip: "并非所有"用 Not all；afford 后面接 to do。

sentences.zh: 即使通过了新法律，政府仍然很难完全阻止网络暴力。
sentences.en: Even if new laws are passed, it is still difficult for the government to stop online bullying completely.
sentences.trap: Even if there have new laws, government is still difficult to stop online bullying.
sentences.tip: 法律是被通过的，用 laws are passed；"政府很难做"用 it is difficult for the government to do。

sentences.zh: 年轻人和老年人都应该学会使用网上银行。
sentences.en: Both young and old people should learn how to use online banking.
sentences.trap: Young people and old people both should learn using online bank.
sentences.tip: Both A and B 放在主语开头；"学会做"用 learn how to do 或 learn to do，不用 learn doing。

sentences.zh: 很多人在社区做志愿者，为了帮助有需要的人。
sentences.en: Many people volunteer in their community in order to help those who are in need.
sentences.trap: Many people do volunteer in community for helping people who need help.
sentences.tip: "为了"用 in order to do；"有需要的人"用 those who are in need。

sentences.zh: 学外语是了解另一种文化的好方法。
sentences.en: Learning a foreign language is a good way to learn about another culture.
sentences.trap: Learn a foreign language is a good method to know another culture.
sentences.tip: 动作做主语用 doing；"……的好方法"用 a good way to do。

sentences.zh: 说到传统节日，很多年轻人更在乎放假，而不是节日习俗。
sentences.en: When it comes to traditional festivals, many young people care more about the holidays than the customs.
sentences.trap: Talking about traditional festivals, many young people care holidays more than customs.
sentences.tip: care 后面要接 about；比较时 more 放在 care 和 about 之间。

sentences.zh: 博物馆应该免费开放，这样就能有更多人去参观。
sentences.en: Entry to museums should be made free so that more people can visit them.
sentences.trap: Museums should free so more people can visit.
sentences.tip: should 后面要有动词；用被动 should be made free；"这样就能"用 so that + can。

sentences.zh: 去一个村庄的游客越多，它传统的生活方式就消失得越快。
sentences.en: The more tourists visit a village, the faster its traditional way of life disappears.
sentences.trap: Tourists more visit a village, its traditional life way disappears faster.
sentences.tip: the more + 名词 + 谓语, the faster + 主语 + 谓语；"生活方式"是 way of life。

sentences.zh: 好电影能让人思考重要的社会问题。
sentences.en: Good films can make people think about important social problems.
sentences.trap: Good films can make people to think important social problems.
sentences.tip: make + 人 + 动词原形，中间不加 to；think 后面要加 about。

sentences.zh: 很多退休老人喜欢在广场上跳舞，这有时会打扰到邻居。
sentences.en: Many retired people enjoy dancing in public squares, which sometimes annoys their neighbours.
sentences.trap: Many retired old people enjoy to dance in squares, this sometimes disturbs neighbours.
sentences.tip: enjoy 后面接 doing；指代前面整件事用 , which，谓语用单数 annoys。

sentences.zh: 很多年轻人每天花好几个小时刷社交媒体。
sentences.en: Many young people spend several hours scrolling through social media every day.
sentences.trap: Many young people spend several hours to brush social media every day.
sentences.tip: spend + 时间 + doing；"刷手机、刷网页"用 scroll through。

sentences.zh: 网上的评论不一定可信，因为其中一些是公司花钱买的。
sentences.en: Online reviews are not always trustworthy because some of them are paid for by companies.
sentences.trap: Online comments are not always believable, because some are bought by companies use money.
sentences.tip: "不一定"用 not always；"其中一些"用 some of them；公司付钱买的用被动 are paid for by。

sentences.zh: 新闻报道应该基于事实，而不是个人观点。
sentences.en: News reports should be based on facts instead of personal opinions.
sentences.trap: News reports should base on facts, not personal opinions.
sentences.tip: "基于"要用被动 be based on；instead of 后面接名词。

sentences.zh: 让很多家长担心的是，孩子花在手机上的时间太多了。
sentences.en: What worries many parents is that their children spend too much time on their phones.
sentences.trap: Many parents worry is that their children spend too much time in phones.
sentences.tip: "让……担心的是"用 What worries … is that + 句子；花在手机上用 spend time on。

sentences.zh: 有些网站让用户很难找到取消订阅的按钮。
sentences.en: Some websites make it hard for users to find the button to cancel their subscription.
sentences.trap: Some websites make users difficult to find the cancel subscription button.
sentences.tip: "让某人很难做"用 make it hard for sb to do，it 不能省；"取消订阅的按钮"用 the button to cancel …。

sentences.zh: 人们往往更愿意相信和自己观点一致的新闻。
sentences.en: People tend to believe news that matches their own opinions.
sentences.trap: People tend to believe the news which is same as their own opinions.
sentences.tip: "往往"用 tend to do；"和自己观点一致的新闻"用 news that matches their own opinions。

sentences.zh: 科学家还在研究，为什么有些人比别人更容易得这种病。
sentences.en: Scientists are still studying why some people are more likely to get this disease than others.
sentences.trap: Scientists are still researching why some people are easier to get this disease than others.
sentences.tip: "更容易得病"是 more likely to get；why 后面用陈述语序。

sentences.zh: 这个实验必须重复很多次，以确保结果准确。
sentences.en: The experiment has to be repeated many times to make sure that the results are accurate.
sentences.trap: This experiment must repeat many times to ensure the result is accurate.
sentences.tip: 实验是被重复的，用被动 has to be repeated；"确保"用 make sure that + 句子。

sentences.zh: 并不是所有科学发现都能马上用在日常生活中。
sentences.en: Not all scientific discoveries can be used in daily life straight away.
sentences.trap: All scientific discoveries can not be used in daily life at once.
sentences.tip: "并非所有"用 Not all；发现是被使用的，用被动 can be used。

sentences.zh: 虽然太空研究很昂贵，但它带来了很多有用的发明，比如更好的手机摄像头。
sentences.en: Although space research is expensive, it has led to many useful inventions, such as better phone cameras.
sentences.trap: Although space research is expensive, but it brought many useful inventions, for example better phone camera.
sentences.tip: Although 和 but 只能用一个；在句中举例用 such as + 名词。

sentences.zh: 如果没有足够的资金，很多研究项目就无法进行。
sentences.en: Unless there is enough funding, many research projects cannot be carried out.
sentences.trap: If there is not enough money, many research projects can't carry out.
sentences.tip: Unless 后面接肯定句；项目是被进行的，用被动 be carried out。

sentences.zh: 这所学校的每个学生都必须参加至少一项课外活动。
sentences.en: Each of the students at this school has to take part in at least one after-school activity.
sentences.trap: Every students in this school must take part in at least one after-school activities.
sentences.tip: "每个……"用 Each of the + 复数名词，谓语用单数 has；one 后面的名词用单数。

sentences.zh: 如果学生睡眠不足，他们上课就会很难集中注意力。
sentences.en: If students do not get enough sleep, they will find it hard to concentrate in class.
sentences.trap: If students sleep not enough, they will be hard to concentrate in class.
sentences.tip: If 从句用一般现在时，主句用 will；"他们很难做"不写 they are hard，用 find it hard to do。

sentences.zh: 学生可以选择在网上考试，也可以去考场考试。
sentences.en: Students can either take the exam online or sit it at a test centre.
sentences.trap: Students can choose online exam, also can choose go to the test center.
sentences.tip: "可以 A 也可以 B（二选一）"用 either A or B，A 和 B 都是动词短语，结构对称。

sentences.zh: 通过每天读英文新闻，你可以学到很多有用的表达。
sentences.en: By reading English news every day, you can learn a lot of useful expressions.
sentences.trap: Through read English news every day, you can learn many useful expression.
sentences.tip: "通过做某事"用 By + doing 放在句首；through 后面不能直接接动词。

sentences.zh: 问题是，很多学生学习只是为了通过考试。
sentences.en: The problem is that many students only study to pass exams.
sentences.trap: The problem is many students study only for pass the exams.
sentences.tip: "问题是……"用 The problem is that + 完整句子；for 后面不能接动词原形，目的用 to do。

sentences.zh: 学校应该让学生为真实生活做好准备，而不只是为了考试。
sentences.en: Schools should prepare students for real life rather than just for exams.
sentences.trap: Schools should let students prepare real life, not only for exams.
sentences.tip: "让某人为……做准备"用 prepare + 人 + for；rather than 前后放同类成分（for real life / for exams）。

sentences.zh: 智能手机最大的问题之一是它们让人分心。
sentences.en: One of the biggest problems with smartphones is that they distract people.
sentences.trap: One of the biggest problem of smartphones are they make people distracted.
sentences.tip: One of the + 最高级 + 复数名词，谓语跟 one 一致用 is；后面接 that + 句子。

sentences.zh: 人们睡前应该避免使用电子设备。
sentences.en: People should avoid using electronic devices before going to bed.
sentences.trap: People should avoid to use electronic products before sleep.
sentences.tip: avoid 后面接 doing；before 是介词，后面也用 doing（before going to bed）。

sentences.zh: 如果没有互联网，人们查找信息会难得多。
sentences.en: If there were no internet, it would be much harder for people to find information.
sentences.trap: If there is no internet, people will be much more difficult to find information.
sentences.tip: 假设和现在事实相反的情况：If + 过去式（were），主句用 would + 动词原形。

sentences.zh: 社交媒体让很多青少年对自己的外表不那么自信了。
sentences.en: Social media has made many teenagers less confident about their appearance.
sentences.trap: Social media made many teenagers become not confident to their looks.
sentences.tip: make + 宾语 + 形容词，中间不加 become；"对外表不自信"用 less confident about one's appearance。

sentences.zh: 尽管网上购物很方便，很多人还是更喜欢在商店买衣服。
sentences.en: Despite the convenience of online shopping, many people still prefer to buy clothes in shops.
sentences.trap: Despite online shopping is convenient, many people still prefer buying clothes in shops.
sentences.tip: Despite 是介词，后面接名词（the convenience of …），不能接句子；接句子要用 Although。

sentences.zh: 很多老人还不习惯用手机付款，所以他们仍然带现金。
sentences.en: Many older people are not used to paying by phone, so they still carry cash.
sentences.trap: Many old people are not used to pay by phone, so they still take cash.
sentences.tip: be used to doing 是"习惯于"，to 是介词，后面接 doing；used to do 才是"过去常常"。

sentences.zh: 这个城市的每户家庭都必须进行垃圾分类。
sentences.en: Each of the households in this city has to sort its rubbish.
sentences.trap: Every families in this city need to classify the garbage.
sentences.tip: Each of the + 复数名词，谓语用单数，代词也用单数 its。

sentences.zh: 如果每个人每周少开一天车，空气就会干净得多。
sentences.en: If everyone drove one day less each week, the air would be much cleaner.
sentences.trap: If everyone drives one day less every week, the air will be cleaner much.
sentences.tip: 这是假设，用 If + 过去式，主句 would；much 放在比较级前面。

sentences.zh: 塑料污染伤害人类健康，也伤害海洋生物。
sentences.en: Plastic pollution harms human health as well as marine life.
sentences.trap: Plastic pollution harms human health, also harms ocean animals.
sentences.tip: 连接两个名词宾语用 as well as，动词不用重复；also 不能用来连接两个句子。

sentences.zh: 我们可以通过少吃肉来减少碳排放。
sentences.en: We can reduce carbon emissions by eating less meat.
sentences.trap: We can through eating less meat to reduce carbon emission.
sentences.tip: "通过做某事来做……"：先说结果 reduce …，再用 by + doing 说方法。

sentences.zh: 缺水给很多农村地区带来了很大压力。
sentences.en: A lack of water has put great pressure on many rural areas.
sentences.trap: Lack of water brings big pressure to many countryside areas.
sentences.tip: "……不足"变成名词短语 a lack of … 做主语；"带来压力"用 put pressure on。

sentences.zh: 许多研究表明，吃早餐对健康有好处。
sentences.en: A number of studies have shown that eating breakfast is good for your health.
sentences.trap: A number of studies has shown that eat breakfast is good to health.
sentences.tip: a number of + 复数名词 = 许多，谓语用复数；the number of 才用单数。

sentences.zh: 很多上班族已经习惯了很晚才吃晚饭。
sentences.en: Many office workers are used to eating dinner late.
sentences.trap: Many office workers are used to eat dinner late.
sentences.tip: be used to doing（习惯于），to 后面接 doing；不要和 used to do（过去常常）混用。

sentences.zh: 如果你每天喝足够的水，你会觉得更有精神。
sentences.en: If you drink enough water every day, you will feel more energetic.
sentences.trap: If you drink water enough every day, you will feel more energy.
sentences.tip: enough 修饰名词放在名词前（enough water），修饰形容词放在形容词后（careful enough）。

sentences.zh: 吃得太多和吃得太少都对身体不好。
sentences.en: Neither eating too much nor eating too little is good for your body.
sentences.trap: Eating too much and eating too little both are not good for body.
sentences.tip: "两个都不"用 Neither A nor B；A、B 都是 doing 时谓语用单数。

sentences.zh: 定期体检可以降低患严重疾病的风险。
sentences.en: Having regular check-ups can reduce the risk of serious illness.
sentences.trap: Do regular body check can reduce the risk to get serious illness.
sentences.tip: 动作做主语用 doing（Having …）；the risk of + 名词。

sentences.zh: 学着做几道健康的菜是很值得的。
sentences.en: It is worth learning to cook a few healthy dishes.
sentences.trap: It is worth to learn cooking a few healthy dishes.
sentences.tip: be worth 后面接 doing；learn 后面接 to do。

sentences.zh: 快餐确实便宜，但往往不健康。
sentences.en: It is true that fast food is cheap, but it is often unhealthy.
sentences.trap: Fast food is indeed cheap, but often is not healthy.
sentences.tip: 先承认再转折可以用 It is true that …, but …；often 放在 be 动词后面。

sentences.zh: 大城市最严重的问题之一是空气污染。
sentences.en: One of the most serious problems in big cities is air pollution.
sentences.trap: One of the most serious problem in big cities are air pollution.
sentences.tip: One of the + 复数名词，谓语用单数 is。

sentences.zh: 这座城市的老街很值得去逛逛，尤其是在晚上。
sentences.en: The old streets in this city are worth visiting, especially in the evening.
sentences.trap: The old streets of this city are worth to visit, especially at evening.
sentences.tip: be worth + doing；"在晚上"是 in the evening。

sentences.zh: 问题是，很多新建的公寓离地铁站太远了。
sentences.en: The problem is that many new flats are too far from metro stations.
sentences.trap: The problem is many new apartments are too far away to subway stations.
sentences.tip: "离……远"用 far from，介词用 from。

sentences.zh: 如果政府不多建学校，很多孩子将不得不走很远的路去上学。
sentences.en: If the government does not build more schools, many children will have to travel a long way to school.
sentences.trap: If government don't build more schools, many children will must go to far place for school.
sentences.tip: will 后面不能再接 must，要说 will have to；government 是单数，用 does not。

sentences.zh: 公共交通在解决交通拥堵方面起着关键作用。
sentences.en: Public transport plays a key role in dealing with traffic jams.
sentences.trap: Public transport plays a key role in solve traffic jam.
sentences.tip: role in 后面接名词或 doing。

sentences.zh: 过去十年里，做自由职业的人越来越多。
sentences.en: The number of people who work as freelancers has increased over the past ten years.
sentences.trap: The number of people who do freelance have increased in recent ten years.
sentences.tip: "……越来越多"写成"……的数量增加了"：the number of …，谓语用单数；"过去十年"用 over the past ten years。

sentences.zh: 很多员工为了避免和老板争吵，选择什么都不说。
sentences.en: Many employees say nothing in order to avoid arguing with their boss.
sentences.trap: Many staffs choose to say nothing for avoiding to argue with boss.
sentences.tip: "为了"用 in order to do；avoid 后面接 doing。

sentences.zh: 很多年轻人宁愿换工作，也不愿做自己不喜欢的工作。
sentences.en: Many young people would rather change jobs than stay in a job they do not enjoy.
sentences.trap: Many young people rather change job than do a job they don't like.
sentences.tip: would rather do A than do B，would 不能省；"换工作"用复数 change jobs。

sentences.zh: 经理希望每个团队都能想出省钱的新办法。
sentences.en: The manager expects every team to come up with new ways to save money.
sentences.trap: The manager hopes every team can think out new methods to save cost.
sentences.tip: expect + 人 + to do（hope 不能这样用）；"想出办法"用 come up with ways。

sentences.zh: 好员工需要专业知识，也需要沟通能力。
sentences.en: A good employee needs communication skills as well as professional knowledge.
sentences.trap: A good staff needs professional skills, also needs communication ability.
sentences.tip: 两个名词宾语用 as well as 连接，不用重复 needs。

sentences.zh: 刚毕业的学生通常需要一段时间才能适应全职工作。
sentences.en: It usually takes new graduates some time to get used to working full-time.
sentences.trap: New graduates usually need some time to get used to work full-time.
sentences.tip: get used to 后面接 doing；"需要一段时间才能"用 It takes + 人 + 时间 + to do。

sentences.zh: 每个人都有权利接受良好的教育。
sentences.en: Everyone has the right to receive a good education.
sentences.trap: Everyone have the right to receive good education.
sentences.tip: Everyone 是单数，谓语用 has；"做……的权利"是 the right to do。

sentences.zh: 如果有更多人在空闲时间做志愿者，我们的社区会友好得多。
sentences.en: If more people volunteered in their free time, our communities would be much friendlier.
sentences.trap: If more people do volunteer in free time, our community will become more friendly.
sentences.tip: 假设情况：If + 过去式，主句 would；friendly 的比较级是 friendlier。

sentences.zh: 政府和慈善机构都不能单独解决贫困问题。
sentences.en: Neither the government nor charities can solve the problem of poverty on their own.
sentences.trap: Both the government and charities can't solve poverty problem alone.
sentences.tip: "两个都不能"用 Neither A nor B；Both … can't 容易被理解成"不是两个都能"。

sentences.zh: 社区活动能把各个年龄的人聚在一起。
sentences.en: Community events can bring people of all ages together.
sentences.trap: Community activities can make different ages people get together.
sentences.tip: bring + 人 + together；"各个年龄的人"是 people of all ages，修饰语放在名词后面。

sentences.zh: 尽管经济在增长，很多年轻人还是找不到工作。
sentences.en: Despite economic growth, many young people still cannot find jobs.
sentences.trap: Although the economy is growing, but many young people still can't find jobs.
sentences.tip: Despite + 名词；或者 Although + 句子。两种写法后面都不能再加 but。

sentences.zh: 中国最受欢迎的节日之一是春节。
sentences.en: One of the most popular festivals in China is the Spring Festival.
sentences.trap: One of the most popular festival in China are the Spring Festival.
sentences.tip: One of the + 最高级 + 复数名词（festivals），谓语用单数 is。

sentences.zh: 通过看电影，人们可以了解其他国家的生活方式。
sentences.en: By watching films, people can learn about the way of life in other countries.
sentences.trap: Through watching films, people can know other countries' life way.
sentences.tip: By + doing 说方法；"其他国家的生活方式"是 the way of life in other countries。

sentences.zh: 互联网确实让文化交流更容易了，但也让一些传统被遗忘了。
sentences.en: It is true that the internet makes cultural exchange easier, but it also causes some traditions to be forgotten.
sentences.trap: The internet indeed makes culture exchange more convenient, but also makes some traditions forgotten.
sentences.tip: 先承认再转折用 It is true that …, but …；"让……被遗忘"可以用 cause … to be forgotten。

sentences.zh: 周末，人们可以去博物馆，也可以去看演出。
sentences.en: At weekends, people can either visit a museum or go to a show.
sentences.trap: In weekend, people can go to museum, also can go to see a show.
sentences.tip: 二选一用 either A or B；"在周末"英式说 at weekends，美式说 on weekends。

sentences.zh: 现在关心本地历史的年轻人越来越少了。
sentences.en: Fewer and fewer young people care about local history these days.
sentences.trap: Young people who care local history are less and less now.
sentences.tip: 可数名词"越来越少"用 fewer and fewer + 复数名词，直接放在句首做主语。

sentences.zh: 许多网站会收集用户的个人信息。
sentences.en: A number of websites collect their users' personal information.
sentences.trap: A number of websites collects users personal informations.
sentences.tip: a number of + 复数名词，谓语用复数 collect；information 不可数，不加 s。

sentences.zh: 如果你在网上分享太多个人信息，你可能会惹上麻烦。
sentences.en: If you share too much personal information online, you will probably get into trouble.
sentences.trap: If you share too many personal informations on internet, you may meet troubles.
sentences.tip: information 不可数，用 too much；"惹上麻烦"是 get into trouble，trouble 不加 s。

sentences.zh: 有些记者为了吸引更多读者，会避免报道复杂的问题。
sentences.en: Some journalists avoid reporting complex issues in order to attract more readers.
sentences.trap: Some journalists avoid to report complicated problems for attracting readers.
sentences.tip: avoid + doing；目的用 in order to do，放在句末。

sentences.zh: 尽管假新闻很多，社交媒体仍然是很多人获取新闻的主要来源。
sentences.en: Despite the amount of fake news, social media is still the main source of news for many people.
sentences.trap: Despite there is a lot of fake news, social media is still many people's main news source.
sentences.tip: Despite 后面接名词短语（the amount of fake news），不能接 there is 句子。

sentences.zh: 很多老人依靠电视获取新闻，比如天气预报和本地消息。
sentences.en: Many older people rely on television for news, such as weather reports and local stories.
sentences.trap: Many old people depend TV to get news, for example weather and local news.
sentences.tip: rely on / depend on 后面都要加 on；句中举例用 such as + 名词。

sentences.zh: 上个世纪最重要的发明之一是电脑。
sentences.en: One of the most important inventions of the last century is the computer.
sentences.trap: One of the most important invention in last century are computer.
sentences.tip: One of the + 复数名词，谓语用 is；"上个世纪"前面要加 the。

sentences.zh: 如果科学家找到治愈癌症的方法，数百万人的生命就会得救。
sentences.en: If scientists found a cure for cancer, millions of lives would be saved.
sentences.trap: If scientists can find the method to cure cancer, millions of people's lives will be saved.
sentences.tip: 这是假设，用 If + 过去式，主句 would；"治愈……的方法"是 a cure for。

sentences.zh: 科学家通过反复检查数据，来确保结果正确。
sentences.en: Scientists make sure their results are correct by checking the data again and again.
sentences.trap: Scientists through checking data again and again to ensure the result is correct.
sentences.tip: 先说目的 make sure + 句子，再用 by + doing 说方法。

sentences.zh: 这项技术可以用于医学，也可以用于农业。
sentences.en: This technology can be used in agriculture as well as in medicine.
sentences.trap: This technology can use in medicine, also can use in agriculture.
sentences.tip: 技术是被使用的，用被动 can be used；两个介词短语用 as well as 连接。

sentences.zh: 问题是，很多研究成果从来没有让公众知道。
sentences.en: The problem is that many research findings never reach the public.
sentences.trap: The problem is that many research results never be known by the public.
sentences.tip: The problem is that + 完整句子；"让公众知道"可以简单说成 reach the public。

sentences.zh: 参加社团是学会与别人合作的好方法。
sentences.en: Joining a club is a good way to learn how to work with others.
sentences.trap: Join a club is a good method to learn working with others.
sentences.tip: 动作做主语用 doing（Joining）；a good way to do；"学会做"用 learn how to do。

sentences.zh: 睡个好觉的关键是白天有足够的运动。
sentences.en: The key to a good night's sleep is getting enough exercise during the day.
sentences.trap: The key of sleeping well is have exercise enough in the daytime.
sentences.tip: the key to + 名词；is 后面用 doing（getting …）；enough 放在名词前。

sentences.zh: 过去十年里，买报纸的人少多了。
sentences.en: Over the past ten years, far fewer people have bought newspapers.
sentences.trap: In the past ten years, people who buy newspapers become much less.
sentences.tip: "过去……年里"用 over the past + 时间，配现在完成时；可数名词"少得多"用 far fewer。

sentences.zh: 买得起市中心房子的家庭越来越少了。
sentences.en: Fewer and fewer families can afford a house in the city centre.
sentences.trap: Families who can afford the city center house are less and less.
sentences.tip: "越来越少的……"用 Fewer and fewer + 复数名词，直接做主语，句子更短。

sentences.zh: 很多专家希望几年后清洁能源会比石油便宜。
sentences.en: Many experts hope that in a few years clean energy will be cheaper than oil.
sentences.trap: Many experts hope clean energy can be more cheap than oil after few years.
sentences.tip: hope that + 句子，用 will；"几年后"是 in a few years，a 不能省（few 单用表示"几乎没有"）。

sentences.zh: 在保护环境这件事上，每个人都有一份责任。
sentences.en: Everyone has a part to play in protecting the environment.
sentences.trap: Everyone have responsibility to protect environment.
sentences.tip: Everyone 后面用单数 has；"在……中有一份责任"可以说 have a part to play in doing。

sentences.zh: 员工有权每年享受带薪假期。
sentences.en: Workers have the right to take paid holidays every year.
sentences.trap: Workers have the right of enjoying paid holiday every year.
sentences.tip: "有权做某事"用 have the right to do；holidays 用复数。

sentences.zh: 学生需要一个安静的地方学习，不被任何东西打扰。
sentences.en: Students need somewhere quiet to study, where nothing can distract them.
sentences.trap: Students need a quiet place to study, there is nothing can disturb them.
sentences.tip: 形容词放在 somewhere 后面（somewhere quiet to study）；补充说明这个地方用 , where + 句子。

sentences.zh: 应该允许年轻人自己决定自己的未来。
sentences.en: Young people should be allowed to make their own decisions about their future.
sentences.trap: Should allow young people make decisions of their own future.
sentences.tip: 英文句子要有主语：让 young people 做主语，用被动 should be allowed to do；"关于……的决定"用 decisions about。
